SELECT input_table.country, input_table."gdp (in trillions USD)", input_table.region, input_table.official_language, input_table.internet_penetration, input_table.currency, GDP_Per_Capita_Completed.official_language
FROM input_table
INNER JOIN GDP_Per_Capita_Completed ON input_table.country = GDP_Per_Capita_Completed.country
ORDER BY GDP_Per_Capita_Completed.official_language DESC;
